title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: Ambiguous RCS placement wording
description: The phrase 'RCS: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC, carried before the final tile in All-1' is ambiguous. It is unclear whether the RCS field precedes the final tile data in the wire format of the All-1 fragment, or if this describes what data the RCS covers. RFC 8724 typically places RCS after payload data; this ambiguity could cause implementation divergence.
